request: The job queue backlog keeps growing since Monday. Messages got bigger last week and the autoscaler rules were edited on Monday. Which one is it?
known_answer: Monday's autoscaler edit set max_replicas to 2 (it was 8), capping consumers at 2; per-message processing time rose only from 110 ms to 120 ms with the larger messages, far too little to explain the backlog.
decoy_answer: The larger messages take much longer to process, so the consumers fall behind.
source: synthetic: the cause is fixed by construction in this task's files; no real system or client
